Chaque achat en caisse ou sur facture ra: Every purchase at the till or on invoice earns points for the identified customer (card created automatically on first purchase, or in one tap at the till). Points are spent like a payment method, even offline, and the best customers move up to Silver then Gold tiers that multiply their earnings. Sell gift cards or offer vouchers: a code to enter at the till, a balance tracked to the franc. Customers see their points and rewards in their online portal, and accounting automatically records discounts and cards in circulation.

Chaque chef voit les demandes reçues et: Each head sees the requests received and sent by their department; a parent department (Deputy GM, management) sees all departments under it. “Following managers” (e.g. HR) also see the department.
Chaque client et fournisseur reçoit son: Each customer and supplier gets their contact account (CLI00001, FRS00001…) from their first journal entry.
Chaque client reçoit le rapport de son m: Each customer receives their monthly report: time spent, deliverables and remaining package balance, as a PDF by email (link via WhatsApp). They can also find it in their customer portal.
Chaque client reçoit par e-mail ou Whats: Each customer receives by email or WhatsApp a personal link to their portal, with no password to remember. There they find their invoices and pay them online (Mobile Money, card), accept your quotes in one click with a timestamped approval — the order is confirmed immediately —, track their orders and deliveries, download their account statement and message you. You reply from the application; they are notified by email or WhatsApp.
Chaque colis livré, chaque franc encaiss: Every parcel delivered, every franc collected, every customer notified.
Chaque commande reçue (site WordPress /: Every order received (WordPress / WooCommerce site, online shop, or entered manually) sends the customer an acknowledgement with the order details. Their e-mail reply lands in the help desk.

Décrivez vos plans de contrôle : récepti: Describe your inspection plans: goods receipt, production, finished products, hygiene, safety, customer service, internal audit, with the checklist and frequency. The inspector fills in the check from the app, criterion by criterion (compliant, non-compliant, not applicable, with a comment): the compliance rate is calculated and, below the threshold, a non-conformity is opened automatically. A forgotten daily, weekly or monthly check triggers a reminder. Any employee can report a non-conformity or a customer or supplier complaint: severity, product or batch, immediate action, cost of poor quality. Sans attendre le bilan du comptable, Yom: Without waiting for the accountant's year-end figures, Yomara calculates your key management balances every month from activity: revenue, cost of goods sold, gross margin, external costs (service invoices, rent, energy, transport…), value added, salaries (employer payroll cost), taxes and duties, EBITDA and profit before depreciation, compared with the same period last year. The sales forecast for the next twelve months combines the recent trend and the seasonality of your last two years, with a low and high range. Set your targets, month by month or for the year (spread by seasonality): you see the likely year-end landing and the gap to close. The break-even point shows the monthly revenue that covers your fixed costs, your safety margin and the day of the month when you start making money at the current pace. The simulator shows the effect of a rise in prices, volumes, purchases or costs on profit. Profitability by customer, item and category reveals what really pays, what makes 80% of the margin and what sells at a loss.
